module "GraphFunctionHoist.dsm"
include "GraphFunctionHoist.dsh"

product 0 Material "M_LiGraphFunctionHoist" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = Reflected[TextureCoordinate](CoordinateIndex=0) : float2 @L14:C21 "uv"
  %1 = Constant(Value=(2)) : float @L17:C21
  %2 = Reflected[Time]() : float @L3:C15 in "GraphFunctionHoist.dsh" via L17:C9
  %3 = Constant(Value=(0)) : float @L4:C31 in "GraphFunctionHoist.dsh" via L17:C9
  %4 = Constant(Value=(0.5)) : float @L4:C54 in "GraphFunctionHoist.dsh" via L17:C9
  %5 = Reflected[LinearInterpolate](A=%3, B=%1, Alpha=%4) : float @L4:C19 in "GraphFunctionHoist.dsh" via L17:C9
  %6 = Custom[LiPulse](uv=%0, Gain=%1, _ds_LiPulse_UE0=%2, _ds_LiPulse_UE1=%5, Code="float pulse = (float)0;\n// Begin DreamShader source: <corpus>/Legacy/IR/Rules/GraphFunctionHoist.dsh\n// DreamShader custom: LiPulse line 2\n\n    float t = _ds_LiPulse_UE0;\n    float mixed = _ds_LiPulse_UE1                        ;\n    pulse = sin(uv.x * 8.0 + t) * mixed;\n// End DreamShader source: <corpus>/Legacy/IR/Rules/GraphFunctionHoist.dsh\nreturn pulse;\n", Description="LiPulse", OutputType="Float1") : [pulse:float] @L17:C9
  %7 = Constant(Value=(4)) : float @L18:C21
  %8 = Reflected[LinearInterpolate](A=%3, B=%7, Alpha=%4) : float @L4:C19 in "GraphFunctionHoist.dsh" via L18:C9
  %9 = Custom[LiPulse](uv=%0, Gain=%7, _ds_LiPulse_UE0=%2, _ds_LiPulse_UE1=%8, Code="float pulse = (float)0;\n// Begin DreamShader source: <corpus>/Legacy/IR/Rules/GraphFunctionHoist.dsh\n// DreamShader custom: LiPulse line 2\n\n    float t = _ds_LiPulse_UE0;\n    float mixed = _ds_LiPulse_UE1                        ;\n    pulse = sin(uv.x * 8.0 + t) * mixed;\n// End DreamShader source: <corpus>/Legacy/IR/Rules/GraphFunctionHoist.dsh\nreturn pulse;\n", Description="LiPulse", OutputType="Float1") : [pulse:float] @L18:C9
  %10 = Multiply(%6, %9) : float @L19:C17 "Alpha"
  %11 = MaterialSink(Opacity=%10) @L6:C1
  sink %11
